title: Conservation of Mass
guideExplore: Toggle the seal, press Play, and watch the balance scale as the reaction turns reactants into products.
guideSealedDemo: Watch a sealed reaction run — nothing can escape, so the balance stays perfectly level the whole time.
guideOpenDemo: Watch an open reaction run — gas escapes into the air, so the container side of the balance rises.
learnMore: The law of conservation of mass: in a chemical reaction, matter is never created or destroyed — the total mass of reactants always equals the total mass of products.
